deviations.why: No booking flow in Vitrina product; no real data for form fields.
No offers model; would require invented discount and code.

deviations.what: Three-column branches adapted to single service areas text
deviations.why: AREAS is a string field, cannot be mapped as array; original branch addresses not available.

notes: Faithful port preserving fixed sidebar navigation, hero with gradient overlay, service cards with price pills, price list with dotted leaders, and open daily card. Layout overflow fixes applied: .hero overflow hidden, .priceListImageWrap and .contactBlockWrap set to box-sizing: border-box with overflow hidden and no extra padding/margin.
